notes: Fixed: when a model provider renames models or changes its API, fallbacks now heal or explain themselves — real reasons, not generic warnings. One-stray-token replies are never sent (the next provider answers instead), and price/news questions always run a real lookup first.
notes_zh: 修复：模型服务改名或改接口时，备用线路会自动修复或说明真正原因，不再只给笼统警告。只有一个字的“假回复”不会再发给你（自动换下一个模型回答），价格与新闻类问题一定先做真实查询。
